name: debt_maturity
title: Debt maturity structure
description: Total interest-bearing debt and when it falls due, as printed in the borrowings note (often 'Note 20' but the number varies by issuer). Amounts only — no interest rates, no covenants. Some reports print two maturity tables on nearby pages: the borrowings note's carrying amounts, and a liquidity-risk note's contractual undiscounted cash flows (includes future interest, a higher total). Read the carrying-amount table — the one whose total ties to interest-bearing borrowings on the balance sheet.
value_convention: Numbers exactly as printed in the maturity table. Unit = the unit stated in the table header (MSEK, SEK m, MEUR, USD m ...). Bucket boundaries follow the report's own columns, which do not always match the three buckets below one-for-one — sum whichever of the report's own columns fall entirely inside a bucket's range (e.g. a first-year split of <3 months + 3-12 months into due_within_1_year, 1-2y + 2-5y into due_1_to_5_years, or 6-10y + >10y into due_after_5_years); see each field's own description.

fields.label: Total borrowings
fields.description: Total interest-bearing debt / borrowings, the row the maturity table sums to (or the note's own total if the maturity table has no total row). Must be a carrying amount that reconciles to interest-bearing borrowings on the balance sheet, not an undiscounted contractual cash-flow total. Include lease liabilities (IFRS 16) only if the report's own note includes them in this total — do not add or remove leases yourself; keep the row's own wording in raw_label so the choice is traceable. 0 if the report states in plain words that it has no interest-bearing debt/borrowings (e.g. an investment company's note saying it holds none) — a sentence, not a numeric row, still makes the value 0, not null.

fields.label: Due within 1 year
fields.description: Amount falling due within one year of the balance sheet date (current portion of borrowings). If the report splits the first year further (e.g. <3 months, 3-12 months), sum those columns. null if the table has no such row — do not enter 0 for a bucket the report doesn't print.

fields.label: Due 1–5 years
fields.description: Amount falling due between one and five years from the balance sheet date. If the report splits this further (e.g. 1-2y, 2-5y), sum those columns. null if the table has no such row — do not enter 0 for a bucket the report doesn't print.

fields.label: Due after 5 years
fields.description: Amount falling due more than five years from the balance sheet date. If the report splits this further (e.g. 6-10y, >10y), sum those columns. null if the table has no such row — do not enter 0 for a bucket the report doesn't print.

checks.name: maturity_sums_to_total
checks.description: A bucket with no row in the table is null upstream (see the bucket fields' description), not a fabricated 0 — but null_as_zero still counts a null bucket as 0 here, so the total is verified against whatever buckets the report does print.
